title: fix: let fmt_nanoplot() draw numeric pandas columns that hold pd.NA

files.patch:
@@ -9369,7 +9369,11 @@ def fmt_nanoplot(
     # on a scale shared by all of the targeted cells (so autoscaling doesn't apply)
     # (dtype names differ between libraries: PyArrow calls float64 `double` and has `decimal128(...)`)
     if col_class.startswith(("int", "uint", "float", "double", "decimal")):
-        all_single_y_vals = [float(v) if isinstance(v, Decimal) else v for v in target_vals]
+        # Missing values (e.g., `pd.NA` in a nullable pandas column) are given as `None`
+        all_single_y_vals = [
+            None if is_na(data_tbl, v) else float(v) if isinstance(v, Decimal) else v
+            for v in target_vals
+        ]
         autoscale = False
     else:
         all_single_y_vals = None

@@ -35,6 +35,21 @@ def test_generate_data_vals_fails_novals():
         _generate_data_vals("abc")
 
 
+def test_fmt_nanoplot_pandas_nullable_float_with_missing_value():
+    np = pytest.importorskip("numpy")
+    pd = pytest.importorskip("pandas")
+
+    values = [1.5, None, 3.0]
+    gt_nullable = GT(pd.DataFrame({"x": pd.array(values, dtype="Float64")}), id="t")
+    gt_numpy = GT(pd.DataFrame({"x": [1.5, np.nan, 3.0]}), id="t")
+
+    html_nullable = gt_nullable.fmt_nanoplot("x").as_raw_html()
+
+    # The missing value gets no plot, and the others share the scale as with a NumPy column
+    assert html_nullable.count("<svg") == 2
+    assert html_nullable == gt_numpy.fmt_nanoplot("x").as_raw_html()
+
+
 def test_generate_data_vals_fails_date_strings():
     with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:
         _generate_data_vals(["2022-01-01"])
